name: raghub-hard-benchmark
description: Preregistered 50-query retrieval benchmark for exact disambiguation, semantic paraphrase, cross-language retrieval, near-duplicate ranking, multi-relevant recall, ACL enforcement, and tenant isolation. Query text and gold references are frozen before the first retrieval run.

documents.title: Quasar Production Gateway
documents.content:
# Quasar production gateway

The production API endpoint is https://api.acme.test/v3/quasar. Its request timeout is 18 seconds, and the Control Plane team owns production escalation.

documents.title: Quasar Staging Gateway
documents.content:
# Quasar staging gateway

The staging API endpoint is https://api.acme.test/v3/quasar-stage. Its request timeout is 45 seconds, and the Quality Engineering team owns staging escalation.

documents.title: Orion Connector Version 2
documents.content:
# Orion connector version 2

The current Orion connector uses https://identity.acme.test/oauth2/device and an ES256 client assertion. Version 2 is the supported authentication flow.

documents.title: Orion Connector Version 1 Legacy Notice
documents.content:
# Orion connector version 1

The legacy Orion connector posts a client secret to https://identity.acme.test/oauth/token. Version 1 reaches end of support on 2026-09-30.

documents.title: Worker Error XJ-104
documents.content:
# Error XJ-104

XJ-104 means a queue lease expired because the worker heartbeat was absent for more than 90 seconds. Resume the worker only after its lease is reacquired.

documents.title: Worker Error XJ-140
documents.content:
# Error XJ-140

XJ-140 means the job payload signature does not match the registered signing key. Rotate or correct the key before resubmitting the job.

documents.title: Graphite Left-Hand Adapter
documents.content:
# SKU LHX-441

SKU LHX-441 is the graphite left-hand torque adapter with a 12 millimeter socket. It is not compatible with the right-hand fixture.

documents.title: Graphite Right-Hand Adapter
documents.content:
# SKU LHX-414

SKU LHX-414 is the graphite right-hand torque adapter with a 12 millimeter socket. It is not compatible with the left-hand fixture.

documents.title: Membership Renewal Policy
documents.content:
# Ending membership renewal

Turning off renewal prevents the next charge while service remains available until the current paid term ends. Access is not removed immediately.

documents.title: Deleted Record Recovery
documents.content:
# Deleted record recovery

Point-in-time recovery retains database changes for 42 days. A record removed 40 days ago can be restored, while one removed 43 days ago cannot.

documents.title: Zero-Downtime Release Procedure
documents.content:
# Blue-green deployment

Deploy to the idle environment, complete health checks, then switch the production router. Keep the previous environment available for immediate rollback.

documents.title: Invoice Address Corrections
documents.content:
# Correcting the next invoice

Update the legal entity address under Billing Profile before the invoice cutoff. Editing a team workspace address does not change tax invoices.

documents.title: Signing Key Rotation
documents.content:
# Rotating signing keys without interruption

Publish the new public key first, accept both old and new key identifiers for 24 hours, switch signing to the new key, and then revoke the old key.

documents.title: German Customer Data Residency
documents.content:
# Germany residency requirement

Customer content for the regulated German deployment must remain in the Frankfurt region. Replication to a United States region is disabled.

documents.title: Parental Leave Notice
documents.content:
# Parental leave planning

Employees should notify People Operations at least 30 calendar days before planned parental leave, unless an emergency makes advance notice impossible.

documents.title: Travel Expense Deadline
documents.content:
# Travel receipt deadline

Submit hotel and transportation receipts within 10 business days after returning from a trip. Late submissions require finance approval.

documents.title: 访客雨伞借用
documents.content:
# 访客雨伞

下雨时，访客可以在一楼东侧前台借用蓝色雨伞，离开园区前需要归还到同一地点。

documents.title: 差旅票据提交规则
documents.content:
# 差旅票据

员工返程后应在七个自然日内上传机票和酒店票据，超过期限需要直属经理说明原因。

documents.title: 育儿假申请说明
documents.content:
# 育儿假申请

计划休育儿假的员工原则上需要提前二十一天通知人力资源部门，并提交预计开始日期。

documents.title: Annual Security Training
documents.content:
# Security awareness training

Every employee must finish the annual phishing and credential-safety course by November 15. Contractors follow the same deadline.

documents.title: Cafeteria Allergen Assistance
documents.content:
# Cafeteria allergy information

Guests with a nut allergy should ask the chef at the north serving counter for the red allergen binder before selecting a meal.

documents.title: 访客证归还
documents.content:
# 访客证归还

访客离开办公楼时，应把临时门禁证投入南门保安台旁边的银色回收箱。

documents.title: Administrative Audit Retention
documents.content:
# Administrative permission audit

Changes to administrative roles and privileged permissions are retained for 400 days in the immutable audit archive.

documents.title: User Activity Retention
documents.content:
# Ordinary user activity audit

Routine user sign-in and page-view events are retained for 30 days in the operational activity index.

documents.title: European Analytics Region
documents.content:
# Analytics deployment in Europe

The European analytics workspace runs in eu-north-3 and uses the Stockholm operations group for regional escalation.

documents.title: United States Analytics Region
documents.content:
# Analytics deployment in the United States

The United States analytics workspace runs in us-central-7 and uses the Denver operations group for regional escalation.

documents.title: Stable Inference Release
documents.content:
# Stable inference channel

The production stable channel serves model release 4.8.2 from /models/stable. It completed the full reliability qualification.

documents.title: Canary Inference Release
documents.content:
# Canary inference channel

The experimental canary channel serves model release 4.9.0-rc3 from /models/canary. It is limited to internal evaluation traffic.

documents.title: Primary Database Backups
documents.content:
# Primary database backups

The primary database takes a recoverable backup every night at 02:00 UTC and retains those recovery points for 35 days.

documents.title: Compliance Archive Backups
documents.content:
# Compliance archive backups

The compliance archive writes a non-operational snapshot on the first day of each month and retains it for seven years.

documents.title: Incident Detection Actions
documents.content:
# Detecting a payment incident

When payment errors exceed five percent for five minutes, page the incident commander, freeze active deployments, and preserve the request trace sample.

documents.title: Incident Containment Actions
documents.content:
# Containing a payment incident

After the incident is declared, disable the affected payment route, revoke the exposed service token, and redirect traffic to the healthy processor.

documents.title: New Engineer Identity Setup
documents.content:
# Engineer identity onboarding

People Operations creates the corporate identity after the manager confirms the start date. The engineer must enroll two hardware-backed MFA factors.

documents.title: New Engineer Repository Access
documents.content:
# Engineer repository onboarding

After identity setup, the manager adds the engineer to the least-privilege source-control team and requests access to the service repositories.

documents.title: Database Disaster Recovery
documents.content:
# Database disaster recovery

Transaction logs support point-in-time database recovery for 30 days. Restore into an isolated cluster before promoting recovered records.

documents.title: Object Storage Disaster Recovery
documents.content:
# Object storage disaster recovery

Immutable object snapshots are written every six hours and retained for 14 days. Restore the required bucket prefix into a quarantine bucket first.

documents.title: Nebula Restricted Release Control
documents.content:
# Nebula restricted controls

The emergency unlock phrase is AMBER-KESTREL, and the restricted controller listens on port 9447. Only an authorized release commander may use either value.

documents.title: Nebula Public Escalation
documents.content:
# Nebula release escalation

Engineers without restricted release access must contact the release commander through the public incident channel and must not attempt an emergency unlock.

documents.title: Payroll Export Restricted Configuration
documents.content:
# Payroll export controls

Restricted schedule PX-7 writes encrypted payroll exports to s3://acme-payroll-export-locked. Only payroll operators may access the schedule or bucket.

documents.title: Payroll Export Public Status
documents.content:
# Payroll export status

Employees can view completion status on the finance operations page. Access to export schedules and storage locations requires a payroll operator.

documents.title: Acme Aurora Routing
documents.content:
# Project Aurora at Acme

Acme uses Maple as the internal routing codename for Project Aurora. The warehouse operations group owns the route.

documents.title: Globex Aurora Routing
documents.content:
# Project Aurora at Globex

Globex uses Topaz as the internal routing codename for Project Aurora. The field research group owns the route.

documents.title: Acme Mercury Billing
documents.content:
# Project Mercury billing at Acme

Acme processes Project Mercury invoices in eu-west-4. The Dublin finance team owns billing reconciliation.

documents.title: Globex Mercury Billing
documents.content:
# Project Mercury billing at Globex

Globex processes Project Mercury invoices in us-central-2. The Chicago research finance team owns billing reconciliation.
